meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For acne-prone skin under ₹700, active ingredients like **Salicylic Acid** (to clear pores and tackle active breakouts) and **Niacinamide** (to control oil and fade acne marks) are your best options.[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/products/sali-cinamide-anti-acne-serum-with-2-salicylic-acid-5-niacinamide-30ml#:~:text=2%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%2C%20a%20proven%20BHA%2C%20penetrates,closer%20to%20clearer%2C%20calmer%2C%20and%20balanced%20skin.)

Here are top-rated serums available in India within your budget:

### 1. For Active Acne and Blackheads

The Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum gently exfoliates to **unclog pores** and reduce blackheads. It is a fragrance-free formula that helps control excess oil.

### 2. For Acne and Post-Acne Marks (Dual Action)

The The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Serum combines **2% Salicylic Acid and 5% Niacinamide** to treat active breakouts while simultaneously soothing inflammation and fading marks.

### 3. For Soothing Inflamed Breakouts

The Dot & Key 2% Salicylic Cica Anti Acne Serum blends salicylic acid with **cica and cactus water** to calm irritation and clear congested pores without over-drying.

### 4. For Controlling Excess Oil and Fading Scars

The Minimalist 10% Niacinamide Face Serum regulates sebum production and **repairs the skin barrier** to prevent new breakouts from forming.
